summary: Iteration 6 — Verified the three new/updated features requested: (A) REAL token-level SSE streaming in AI Chat, (B) public /gallery, (C) /backoffice admin panel with full user & org control. All three passed on the live public URL (https://git-hub-access-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend endpoints spot-checked via curl (public gallery 200, admin login 200). Regression flows were already validated in iteration_5.

A_streaming_chat.evidence: MutationObserver on [data-testid='chat-msg-assistant'] captured 94 unique length increments spanning 2915ms for a 952-char reply (~30ms between deltas). First delta arrived at 1135ms, growth was gradual (0 -> 10 -> 21 -> 31 -> 34 -> 44 -> 51 -> 60 -> 71 -> 85 -> 102 -> 121 -> ... -> 952). Previous iteration_5 flagged the old endpoint as fake streaming; this iteration confirms the FIX is real. Credits sidebar updated 199 -> 198 after completion (refreshUsage() fired on {done}).

B_public_gallery.evidence: GET /gallery loads without auth. Filter chips render for all 6 kinds (all/image/video/music/document/research) with correct data-testid=gallery-filter-<kind>. Multiple items already shared and rendered (images, videos, docs, research, audio). Media component fetches /api/public/creations/{token}/file as blob and displays properly (images inline, videos with controls, audio with controls). Cards link to /share/<token>. Header shows 'Create yours' CTA to /register. Backend curl to /api/public/gallery returned 200 with populated JSON.

C_backoffice.status: PASS - all admin actions working incl. self-protection

evidence.negative_login: Registered fresh non-admin nonadm_5118@... -> login through backoffice form -> toast 'This account is not an administrator.' displayed, form remained visible (not redirected).

evidence.users_tab: admin-tab-users renders 44 admin-user-row-<id> rows. admin-search filters (search 'nonadm_5118' -> 1 row).
evidence.role_toggle: toggle-role-<id> switched non-admin -> admin (button text flipped to 'Make user'); flipped back OK.

evidence.self_protection: Attempting to demote admin@aiplatform.com returned HTTP 400 (visible in console); admin remained admin (button still 'Make user'). Same guard applies to self-delete per backend contract.
evidence.orgs_tab: admin-tab-orgs renders 31 org rows. add-credits-<id>: NonAdm's Org 200 -> 700 (+500). toggle-plan-<id>: Free -> Pro (and back). set-credits-<id>: prompt=9999 -> row shows 9999 credits. All actions reflected after load() re-fetch.

ui_bugs.issue: When admin clicks 'Make user' on their own row, backend correctly returns 400 (blocked), but the frontend catches with `toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed')`. The detail message shown to the user was captured only in console (400). Confirm the toast surfaces the FastAPI detail (e.g., 'Cannot demote yourself') so admins understand why nothing happened. Minor — action is blocked as designed.

ui_bugs.component: Gallery filter=all vs kind='all' backend contract
ui_bugs.issue: Gallery.js sends ?kind=all when 'All' tab selected. If backend `/public/gallery` filters strictly on kind, this would return zero when 'all' is chosen. In practice it worked (items returned), so backend likely ignores kind=='all' — good — but worth confirming the query handling to avoid silent regressions.

action_items: Optional: surface backend detail message in Backoffice self-protect toast (currently generic 'Failed').
critical_code_review_comments: llm/gateway.py stream_text: now uses SDK LlmChat.stream_message and yields TextDelta.content — verified via UI mutation observer (94 deltas over ~3s, ~30ms cadence). This is the fix requested in iteration_5.

Backoffice.js: /auth/me is called on mount before login to auto-hydrate an already-logged-in admin — good UX. However, the 401 responses on non-authed visits are logged to console; consider silencing (already caught, but console noise is visible in preview).
Backoffice.js addCredits/setPlan/setCredits catch blocks show only generic 'Failed' — should surface e.response?.data?.detail like setRole/delUser do.
Gallery.js Media component: no error UI if blob fetch fails — a permanently spinning dot is shown. Minor.

Backoffice.js Panel: on tab switch to users/orgs the search input is shared (same `q` state) but not cleared between tabs — filtering 'admin' on users tab then switching to orgs keeps the filter which may confuse users. Consider resetting q on tab change.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The three new features (real SSE streaming, /gallery, /backoffice) are fully functional on the public URL. For streaming validation, don't rely on pytest length polling — instead use a client-side MutationObserver on [data-testid='chat-msg-assistant'] to capture per-delta growth (see this iteration's script). Backoffice /admin/* endpoints all live under /api/admin/. Non-admin visitors are blocked on the frontend AND backend (403). Admin cannot demote/delete self (backend 400). Gallery is public (no auth) and already contains ~7 items from previous iterations.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found this iteration.
